sources.measurement_method: Used only the FID 506 Building F polygon. Inverse Web Mercator to WGS84, then the project's documented local campus approximation from origin latitude 40.4274, longitude -86.9137; X east and Y north, metres. Result agrees with the project snapshot of the same FID within about 0.0001 m.
sources.uncertainty: The feature is explicitly in a pre-planning layer and is not a certified or as-built survey. It crosswalks to BLDG F / 143 in the county's approved detailed construction plan, and its transformed outline closely matches the 2025 roof outline in current orthophoto. This strongly supports the assigned block identity and footprint location; exact wall-line registration remains approximate because GIS is pre-planning and the orthophoto shows roof/eaves, not walls. The legacy asset AABB was much wider than this feature; it was replaced rather than used as a neighbor footprint.

sources.measurement_method: Read the explicit BLDG F / 143 label in the apartment group north of District Boulevard, between BLDG E / 144 and BLDG G / 142. Compared its plan silhouette and orientation qualitatively with GIS FID 506 and the current orthophoto. This sheet is an erosion-control / construction-plan sheet, not an architectural elevation, and the PDF is not georeferenced; it is used for identity and proposed site layout, not surveyed dimensions.
sources.uncertainty: Approved detailed construction plans provide a direct label and planned site location, not an as-built certification. The exact stable asset crosswalk is an evidence-based inference from the inherited .005 object's campus location, the explicit F/143 plan feature, and current roof imagery. No plan-level elevation or facade schedule was located.

geometry_actions: Inspected the inherited mesh and found one low-detail 12-vertex object with a 138.148 m by 28.382 m AABB, compared with FID 506 plan envelope.
Rebuilt the single assigned asset from Purdue GIS FID 506 only; no adjacent Provenance footprint was reused.

Crosswalked the assigned block to BLDG F / 143 using the county approved construction-plan sheet C1.4 and current 2025 orthophoto. The GIS ring closely matches the roof outline, but is not a surveyed wall registration.
Used three stories only as project-level evidence. The 8.9 m eave and 11.4 m ridge are estimates ±1.5 m; no F/143 elevation or section was located.
Retained a five-break roof rhythm as an estimate from exact-block overhead imagery. Ridge count, ridge placement, pitch, and heights are unmeasured.

Removed unsupported windows, frames, balconies, entries, canopies, and facade color/material stationing. The shell uses neutral display materials and has no facade relief because no exact-block street image or elevation was found.
unresolved: The county plan supports BLDG F / 143 identity and planned position. Purdue FID 506 remains a pre-planning feature; its ring matches the current roof outline closely but cannot establish surveyed wall registration.

No Building F / 143 street-level image, approved elevation, or section was located in the accessible sources. Facade openings, entries, balconies, finishes, and color stationing remain unknown and are omitted.
No measured Building F height was found. The project description supports three stories; 8.9 m eave / 11.4 m ridge remain estimates with about ±1.5 m uncertainty.
The five-break roof rhythm is inferred from current overhead imagery; exact ridge count, placement, pitch, seam locations, and elevations remain uncertain.
